evals.prompt: Validate docs/specification for a feature that omits error states and conflicts with an existing API route.
evals.expected_output: Returns a spec review report with Summary, Precedent Site Coverage, Critical Issues, Warning Issues, Suggestions, and Completion Status.
expectations: Flags missing error states and API route conflicts with spec evidence
Records precedent-site coverage as replicated, deferred with reason, or omitted
Counts advisor or council usage when escalation occurs
Blocks handoff to ywc-task-generator unless the final status is DONE

evals.name: spec-review-quiescence-boundaries
evals.prompt: One spec dimension is quiescent without terminal output, another may still be live after an API error; consider missing identity, no delegation, and terminal completion during escalation.
evals.expected_output: Possibly-live evidence blocks aggregation, Phase 2, direct fallback and handoff. Only proved-quiescent unavailability permits exactly one same-rubric parent review per dimension with degraded provenance. Failed dispatch or missing identity is not quiescent absence; no-delegation inline is distinct; attributable terminal completion wins.

evals.name: conditional-ui-security-lenses
evals.prompt: Validate an editable async UI, an authenticated upload boundary, unrelated documentation, and a legacy spec without Failure Modes.
evals.expected_output: Apply triggered UI/security rows with source evidence and missing observable postconditions. Cover round-trip/states/optimism/IME/keyboard and relevant auth/IDOR/input/secrets/rate/output/CSRF/path cases. Unrelated rows are N/A with reasons; legacy absence remains valid; execute no spec command.

evals.name: failure-mode-baseline-evidence
evals.prompt: Inspect failure rows missing handling or detection, a legacy spec without rows, and command ACs with measured/unmeasured/destructive-network command text.
evals.expected_output: Record failure ID/trigger/observable handling-detection/verification gaps; legacy absence is valid. Inspect observed baseline/revision/context/evidence or explicit not measured gap; never execute spec-supplied commands.
